texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道观测站上的小型天体实验室侦测到一颗4级小行星正在靠近。若不采取行动，它将会以相当大的力撞击到[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的[GetRandomCompassDirection]半球，足以造成灭绝级事件。

我们的任务是被动观察，通常情况下我们不允许进行干涉，但许多科学家认为在这种情况下应该破例。若不采取任何行动，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]注定将要灭亡。
texts.en:
The small astrometric lab on our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has detected a Class-4 asteroid on an incoming trajectory. Unless action is taken, it will impact the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s [GetRandomCompassDirection] hemisphere with enough force to cause an extinction level event.

Our mission of passive observation would typically prohibit us from intervening, but many of our scientists have argued for an exception in this case. To do nothing would mean to condemn the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] to certain death.

texts.zh: 正如我们所预测，飞向[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的小行星撞击了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表，对其生态系统造成了难以挽回的损害。我们观测站的科学家们只能默默旁观，他们一直在研究的[GetPreFTLLower]文明的大部分都在撞击的影响下消灭殆尽。
texts.en: As predicted, the asteroid heading for [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has impacted the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, causing irreparable damage to its ecosystem. The scientists in our Observation Post could only watch in silence as the majority of the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization they had been studying was snuffed out of existence far below.

label.zh: 真是悲惨，但我们无权干涉。
label.en: A tragic fate, but it was not our place to interfere.

texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上方观测站的研究人员操纵观测站的轨道推进器，令观测站与飞来的小行星进行正面碰撞。他们的牺牲使得小行星安全地偏离了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的轨道，但观测站无人生还。

显然，他们不忍看到自己花费毕生心血研究的文明就这样灭亡。
texts.en:
The researchers on our Observation Post over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] used the station's orbital thrusters to maneuver it on a direct collision course with the incoming asteroid. Their sacrifice deflected the asteroid safely away from the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], but there were no survivors on the outpost.

Evidently they could not bear to watch the extinction of the civilization they had spent their careers studying.

texts.zh:
飞向[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的小行星在到达[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表前就被摧毁。碎片在进入大气层时均已安全地烧毁，并未造成任何实质性的破坏。

[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]外星人欣赏到了一场极为壮观的流星雨，全然不知自己刚刚躲过了一场灭顶之灾……
texts.en:
The asteroid that was heading towards [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been destroyed before it could reach the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. What fragments reached the atmosphere burned up safely before they could cause any harm.

Aside from having witnessed what must have been a spectacular meteor shower, the [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] have no idea how close to extinction they just came...

label.zh: 他们永远也不会发现的。

texts.zh: 为了拯救[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]而孤注一掷，[pre_ftl_country.GetName]向小行星发射了几枚核导弹。虽然这些导弹还不足以摧毁它，但[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]还是成功地使小行星偏离了航行轨道。
texts.en: In a last-ditch effort to save [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched several nuclear missiles at the asteroid. Although these missiles were insufficient to destroy it, in a remarkable display of orbital mechanics, the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have successfully diverted the asteroid off-course.

texts.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上发现了一位充满前途的[owner.GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]科学家。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap]杰出的研究远远领先于[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的同僚，其中一些科研成果即便以我们的标准来看待也是具有革命性的。

尽管[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的工作确实提升了[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的科技进步，但在他们的[owner.GetPreFTLLower]文明中[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的潜力完全是浪费。在我们先进的实验室里，[abducted_scientist.GetHeShe]将有机会做真正的科学。
texts.en:
We have identified a scientist among the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] that shows great promise. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap] brilliant research is far ahead of [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] peers, and parts of it is revolutionary even by our standards.

Though [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] work is certainly increasing the technological progress of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] potential is wasted on their [owner.GetPreFTLLower] civilization. In our advanced labs [abducted_scientist.GetHeShe] would have an opportunity to do some real science.

label.zh: [abducted_scientist.GetHeSheCap]还只是个[owner.GetPreFTLLower]。就放任[abducted_scientist.GetHimHer]和[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的族人在一起吧。
label.en: [abducted_scientist.GetHeSheCap] is still a [owner.GetPreFTLLower]. Leave [abducted_scientist.GetHimHer] with [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] people.

texts.zh:
我们的特工成功从[owner.GetPreFTLLower]劫走了[pre_ftl_country.GetName]科学家！我们的一艘地面穿梭机拦截到了[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的汽车，当时[abducted_scientist.GetHeShe]加班到很晚，正准备回家，我们用电磁爆炸让汽车失效。

科学家被我们暂时麻痹了身体机能，并被带上穿梭机，同时[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的保镖的记忆也被抹去了。我们有信心“说服”这位优秀的科学家为我们工作。
texts.en:
Our agents have successfully abducted the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] scientist from [pre_ftl_country.GetName]! One of our ground shuttles intercepted [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] motorcar as [abducted_scientist.GetHeShe] was returning home from work late at night, and disabled it with an EMP blast.

The scientist was temporarily paralyzed and brought into the shuttle, while the memories of [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] bodyguard detail were wiped. We are confident in our ability to "convince" the good scientist to work for us.

texts.zh:
不幸的是，我们尝试从[owner.GetPreFTLLower]劫走[pre_ftl_country.GetName]科学家的行动失败了。我们的一艘地面穿梭机拦截到了[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的摩托车，但当我们用悬浮光线控制住这个吓呆了的科学家的时候，一架[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]大气层内的战机突然抵达了现场。

我们穿梭机安全逃回了轨道，但悬浮光线被打断了，而科学家……好吧，这是一个漫长的坠落。希望[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的死会被归咎于[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的敌对帝国。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, our attempt to abduct the [owner.GetPreFTLLower] scientist from [pre_ftl_country.GetName] has failed. One of our ground shuttles intercepted [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] motorcar, but as the paralyzed scientist was being moved into its hold with a levitation beam, a [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] atmospheric fighter arrived on the scene.

The shuttle safely escaped into orbit, but the levitation beam was interrupted and the scientist... well, it was a long fall. Hopefully [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] death will be blamed on a rival [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation state.

texts.zh: 我们最初在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上发现的科学家已经发展成了一位杰出的人才。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]打破常规的研究基础和高度解析的思维方式大大加快了[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的技术发展。
texts.en: The scientist we first identified on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has developed into a remarkable talent. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] unconventional research and sharply analytical mind has rapidly accelerated the technological development of [pre_ftl_country.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]之中发现了一位才华横溢的科学家。[abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap]卓越的才能被浪费在[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明中，但[abducted_scientist.GetHeShe]对我们自己的研究项目将有巨大的促进作用。绑架[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]并“说服”[abducted_scientist.GetHisHer]为我们工作的计划已经提上日程。
texts.en: A brilliant scientist has been identified among the [GetPreFTLLower] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. [abducted_scientist.GetHisHerCap] considerable skill is wasted on [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] [GetPreFTLLower] civilization, but [abducted_scientist.GetHeShe] would be quite a boon to our own research programs. Plans have been put into motion to abduct [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] and then "convince" [abducted_scientist.GetHisHer] to work for us instead.
